name: nut-upsd
title: NUT UPS Server
description: Network UPS Tools server for a USB-connected UPS. Publishes battery charge, runtime and mains status on port 3493, which the DCS power watch reads to alert you and stop the stacks cleanly before the battery runs out.

variables.name: UPS_NAME
variables.label: UPS Name
variables.description: Name clients use (also UPS_NAME in the DCS power settings)

variables.name: UPS_DRIVER
variables.label: Driver
variables.description: NUT driver: usbhid-ups covers most USB units (APC, CyberPower, Eaton); see networkupstools.org for others

variables.name: UPS_PORT
variables.label: Port / Device
variables.description: auto for USB, or a serial device path

variables.name: PORT_NUT
variables.label: Host Port
variables.description: Port to publish the NUT server on
